name: Krasnyj kosmos
source:
Year 2150. Mankind explores space which becomes a battlefield between the USA and the USSR while things at the Earth remain relatively calm.
In one fight light spaceship "Yury Andropov" gets damaged and jumps to the hyperspace. It appears in a barely explored space segment. Its staff starts to experience strange issues... a computer game!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-september-2007-tsurugi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
